exams.name: Perfusion licensing examination (at least as stringent as ABCP certification examination)
exams.notes: The board must use an examination at least as stringent and comprehensive as the ABCP certification examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state board (using standard at least as stringent as ABCP national exam)
exams.quote: When examining an applicant for a license to practice perfusion under par. (a), the board shall use an examination at least as stringent and comprehensive as the certification examination used by the American Board of Cardiovascular Perfusion or its successor.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed or certified under this subchapter shall register on or before November 1 of each odd-numbered year following issuance of the license or certificate with the board.

required.quote: Each person licensed as a perfusionist shall include with his or her application for a certificate of registration under s. 448.07 proof of completion of continuing education requirements promulgated by rule by the board.

available.quote: Actual consultation or demonstration by licensed physicians or perfusionists or certified respiratory care practitioners of other states or countries with licensed physicians or perfusionists or certified respiratory care practitioners of this state.

requirements.value: A person practicing perfusion for not more than 30 days in a year is exempt if certified or eligible to be certified as a clinical perfusionist by ABCP. No formal endorsement/reciprocity statute for perfusionists found; the statute provides limited temporary practice exemptions.
requirements.quote: A person practicing perfusion for not more than 30 days in a year, if the person is certified or eligible to be certified as a clinical perfusionist by the American Board of Cardiovascular Perfusion.

title_protection.quote: A person who is not licensed to practice perfusion by the board may not designate himself or herself as a perfusionist, use or assume the title "licensed perfusionist" or the abbreviation "L.P.," or use any other title, letters, or designation that represents or may tend to represent the person as a perfusionist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may warn, reprimand, limit, suspend, or revoke license upon finding of unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: after a disciplinary hearing, the board may, when it determines that a panel established under s. 655.02, 1983 stats., has unanimously found or a court has found that a person has been negligent in treating a patient or when it finds a person guilty of unprofessional conduct or negligence in treatment, do one or more of the following: warn or reprimand that person, or limit, suspend or revoke any license or certificate granted by the board to that person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may discipline licensee found guilty of negligence in treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: when it finds a person guilty of unprofessional conduct or negligence in treatment, do one or more of the following: warn or reprimand that person, or limit, suspend or revoke any license or certificate granted by the board to that person

disciplinary_grounds.description: No registration permitted for perfusionist who has failed to meet continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No registration may be permitted by the secretary of the board in the case of any physician or perfusionist who has failed to meet the requirements of s. 448.13

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may deny application on basis of unprofessional conduct or failure to meet educational requirements or examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may deny an application for any class of license or certificate and refuse to grant such license or certificate on the basis of unprofessional conduct on the part of the applicant, failure to possess the education and training required for that class of license or certificate for which application is made, or failure to achieve a passing grade in the required examinations.

definition_quote.value: "Perfusion" means that branch or system of treating the sick that is limited to the operation and management of extracorporeal circulation to support, temporarily replace, measure, treat, or supplement the cardiopulmonary and circulatory system of a patient, including, when necessary to and part of the management and operation of extracorporeal circulation, the use of blood testing and advanced life support techniques and technologies, autotransfusion, and the administration of blood, blood products, and anesthetic and pharmacological agents.
definition_quote.quote: "Perfusion" means that branch or system of treating the sick that is limited to the operation and management of extracorporeal circulation to support, temporarily replace, measure, treat, or supplement the cardiopulmonary and circulatory system of a patient, including, when necessary to and part of the management and operation of extracorporeal circulation, the use of blood testing and advanced life support techniques and technologies, autotransfusion, and the administration of blood, blood products, and anesthetic and pharmacological agents.
